title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full Workload Backup policies for SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout dates, opt-in requirement, storage pricing and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections would complete the notification path and narrow the Backup Administrator description to the three workloads covered here.

claims.quote: allows admins to quickly protect an entire workload (SharePoint, OneDrive, or Exchange) with a single policy.

claims.claim: The feature covers SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts and Exchange mailboxes.
claims.quote: Full Workload Backup provides automatic protection for all eligible SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, or Exchange mailboxes in your organization
